name: Royal Duality: The Waiting Room
source:
Welcome to the Lake District! Unpack your bags, get comfortable and get to know your room-mate...a ghost from another realm.

The Waiting Room gives those who have passed away in the Fae Kingdom of Olesa Machna a second chance at life...on Earth.

Meanwhile, 4 men from Earth find their fate in the hands of the despicable changeling narrator, Nol. 

Only one question remains, will these 4 men check-out as themselves...or will their 'room-mate' ghosts have completely taken over their lives?

This supernatural mystery game will allow you to decide their fate... 

[Edited from [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/the-waiting-room]itch.io[/url]]
